AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Reset Token Expires
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Expiration timestamp for the local password reset token.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Period
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Reporting period for the fiscal declaration (e.g. 01 for January, 1T for Q1).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Is Person
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Indicates whether the business partner is a person (Y) or a company (N).
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: When set to Y, the Contacts window displays first name and last name fields instead of the commercial name. Defaults to N (company).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Spec Type
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Specifies whether this spec maps to a Window (W) or a Process (P)

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Spec Name
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Identifier of the Schema Forge spec that owns this file (e.g. sales-invoice).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Web
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: A website URL for a specified business partner.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: The Web field identifies the website associated with the record.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Total Discount %
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Total discount percentage applied to this document by Etendo GO.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Stores the total discount percentage set by the user in the Etendo GO interface. Etendo GO uses this value to insert a negative discount line on the document and to restore the discount panel when the document is reopened. This field is managed exclusively by Etendo GO — do not edit it manually in Classic, as doing so will not recalculate the discount line.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Amount Tolerance Pct
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Allowed amount tolerance, in percent.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Maximum percentage difference accepted when matching the line amount (0 = exact).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Visibility
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Field visibility classification: editable, readOnly, system, or discarded

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Fiscal Model
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Fiscal model number for this declaration (e.g. 303, 347).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Match Rule
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Unique identifier of the matching rule.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Internal ID of the bank-reconciliation matching rule.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Create Transaction
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Create the transaction automatically.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: If active, the rule creates the transaction on a match; otherwise it only suggests it.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Declaration Type
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Type of fiscal declaration: O (ordinary) or C (complementary).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Patch
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Allows partial updates on the Schema Forge entity endpoint
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Enable this flag to expose PATCH operations for the configured Schema Forge entity.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Match Count
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Number of reconciliations made by this rule.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Read-only counter, increased when a suggestion from this rule is accepted.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Contract Name
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Versioned transactional email contract name.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Record Type
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Email safety record type: audit, throttle, or kill switch.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Reconciliation Status
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Reconciliation status of the bank statement.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Password Changed
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp of the latest local password change.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Priority
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Evaluation order of the rule.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Rules are evaluated in ascending order: the lower the number, the higher the priority.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: File External
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Indicates whether the declaration file is stored externally (Y) or embedded in the record (N).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Agent Prompt
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Guidance text returned to AI agents via the NEO Headless MCP server.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Payload
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Redacted JSON payload for email safety audit and controls.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Bucket Key
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Normalized key used for email throttles and kill switches.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Schema Forge Spec
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Schema Forge API Specification

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Schema Forge Entity
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Schema Forge Entity configuration

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Window Seconds
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Throttle window duration in seconds.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Transaction Type
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Category of the transaction the rule creates.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Bank fee, Transfer, Tax or retention, Recurring payment, or Other.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Discount %
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: The proportional discount given to an item, without respect to any previously defined discounts.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: The Discount indicates the discount applied or taken as a percentage.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Lines
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Number of active lines in the bank statement.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: MIME Type
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: MIME type of the stored preview file (e.g. application/pdf, image/jpeg).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Delete
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Allows delete operations on the Schema Forge entity endpoint
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Enable this flag to expose DELETE operations for the configured Schema Forge entity.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Declaration Status
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Current workflow status of the fiscal declaration (e.g. draft, submitted).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Amortization Status
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Depreciation progress as a percentage (0–100). Maintained by a trigger on every insert/update of the asset row.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Number percentage computed, capped at 100. Returns 0 when no depreciation plan is defined. Maintained automatically by a trigger on every asset insert/update.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Scope
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Email safety scope such as global, tenant, template, recipient, or actor.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Total Out
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Sum of withdrawal (debit) amounts of the bank statement.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Template
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Provider template associated with the email contract.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: EtendoGo Account
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: EtendoGo platform user account

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Session Token
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Active session token for platform authentication

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Matched Lines
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Number of reconciled lines in the bank statement.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Auth Provider
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: External SSO provider associated with the platform account.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Stores the external SSO provider associated with the platform account, for example Google.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Fiscal Year
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Fiscal year the declaration applies to (e.g. 2024).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: External Subject
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Stable external subject identifier asserted by the SSO provider.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Stores the stable subject identifier asserted by the external SSO provider.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Window Start
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Start timestamp for the current throttle window.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Max Attempts
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Maximum allowed email attempts for the throttle window.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Text Pattern
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Text the rule looks for in the statement line.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Pattern matched against the line description, counterparty or reference.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: External Email
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Email claim asserted by the SSO provider at link time.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Stores the email address asserted by the external SSO provider during the latest SSO login.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Name
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Name of the matching rule.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Descriptive name shown in the rules list (for example Bank fees).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Identifier
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: The sequence indicates the order for the properties within the identifier.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: The sequence indicates the order for the properties within the identifier.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: File Data
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Base64-encoded binary content of the preview file.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Managed exclusively by the NEO Headless preview-file endpoint. Do not edit manually.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Transaction Type
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Transaction type of the bank reconciliation matching rule.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Tenant ID
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Tenant identifier used by the transactional email safety store.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Audit Time
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp when the email audit event was recorded.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Schema Forge Field
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Schema Forge Field configuration

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Status
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Email safety or delivery status.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Email
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Email address of the account

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Fiscal Declaration
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Unique identifier for a fiscal declaration record.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Java Qualifier
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Java Qualifier

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: File Name
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Original file name including extension (e.g. invoice-1000071.pdf).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Legacy
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Marks the Schema Forge definition as relying on legacy compatibility behavior
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Enable this flag only when the spec or entity requires legacy behavior for backward compatibility.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Password Hash
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Salted SHA-256 hash of the account password

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Declaration File Name
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Original file name of the submitted fiscal declaration document (e.g. modelo303_2024_01.xml).

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Email Safety
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Unique identifier for an email safety record.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Last SSO Login
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp of the last successful SSO login for the account.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Stores the timestamp of the latest successful SSO login for the account.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Reset Token Hash
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Server-side hash of the local password reset token.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Populate
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Populate entities and fields from the selected window

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: ETGO Preview File
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Unique identifier for a preview file record.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Idempotency Key
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Idempotency key used to prevent duplicate email delivery.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Total In
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Sum of deposit (credit) amounts of the bank statement.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Text Condition
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: How the pattern is matched against the statement line.
AD_ELEMENT.HELP: Contains, Starts with or Regex, applied to the statement line concept.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Attempt Count
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Number of email attempts counted in the throttle window.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Reset Token Consumed
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp when the local password reset token was consumed.

AD_ELEMENT.NAME: Record ID
AD_ELEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Primary key of the source document this preview file belongs to.
